p: Crofton Roman Villa, Crofton Rd, Orpington
Apr-Oct, Bank Holidays, Wed Fri 10AM-1PM and 2PM-5PM, Sun 2PM-5PM

The only villa open to the public in Greater London. It was inhabited from about AD 140-400 and was the centre of a large farming estate. Today you can see the remains of 10 rooms protected inside a public viewing building. Remains…
